name: Wordmark closes beside an engraved solid
looks: An engraved study of a geometric solid sits on the left, orbited by a single thin accent-coloured ellipse with one small dot riding its path; beside it, the brand's asterisk mark and wordmark settle on the warm paper ground, holding for a breath before the frame cuts to black.
build: The engraved solid and its orbiting ellipse are already mid-motion when the shot opens (ellipse slowly rotating, `strokeDashoffset` steady); the mark and wordmark arrive together (`y:8px -> 0`, power2.out, ~300ms) a beat later. Hard cut to a full black frame closes the film.
sound: Near silence under the hold, a single soft low tone under the cut to black.
prompt: Close beside a piece of antique engraving artwork orbited by one thin accent ellipse and dot, settling the brand's mark and wordmark onto the same warm paper ground a beat later, holding briefly, then cutting hard to black to end the film.
